Please tell me we got some anti-air ready!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 29 ([[Fallen Mode|Formerly, Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Seraph''' is a [[Flying]] [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It is the first flying enemy the player encounters in the mode. As it is a flying enemy, only towers with flying detection can target it. It has a decent amount of health and decent speed. == Logbook Description == "''Fallen Seraphs were the kingdom's messengers, blessed with wings to carry word from Two X's throne. They flew above the realm, often heard singing tales of the kingdom's history. When the Queen's curse spread, their songs grew quiet, and their wings changed from a vibrant glistening scarlet to coal black.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Seraph''' has blue skin. Its torso and legs are dark blue. It has dark blue wings on its back. It also has a dark blue halo above its head with dark blue chains on its torso. ==Strategy== *Towers with flying detection, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Militant]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Ace Pilot]] are recommended against this. **As they spawn in hordes, the [[Tesla]], [[Mortar]] and [[Hallow Punk]] can be useful against them. *The [[Commander]]'s ''Support Caravan'' ability can be useful against these enemies, as the [[Gunner APC]] and [[Missile APC]] have flying detection. *While the '''Fallen Seraph''' does not have any immunities, it gains an immunity to being knocked back which is given by default to any [[Flying]] enemy. **This means that towers like the [[DJ Booth]], [[Brawler]] or [[Warlock]] are fully or partially unable to stall it. *The [[UAV]] can be useful by providing flying detection to your towers. *The [[Gift Bomber]] cannot collide with the '''Fallen Seraph'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenSeraphFly.gif|Flying animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenSeraph.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenSeraph.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tesla Tower Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Seraph''' on a promotional video. Enforcer Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Seraph''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Valentines Skins - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Seraph''' in the game trailer. Medic & Turret Update Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Seraph''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexFallenSeraph.png|'''Fallen Seraph''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *In Christianity, a [[wp:Seraph|seraph]] is a class of [[wp:Angel|angel]] with six wings. **Oddly, the [[Fallen Angel]] bears more similarity to a seraph, leading to the possibility that the names of these two enemies were switched. *The '''Fallen Seraph''' looks very similar to the [[Crying Angel (Krampus Frosthold)|Crying Angel]] from [[Krampus Frosthold]] and the [[Crying Angel]] from [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. ==Update History== *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **'''Fallen Seraph''' added. *'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.67.0]] **Health increased from 500 to 750. **Speed decreased from Fast (6) to Above Average (4). **Cash given increased from {{Money|500}} to {{Money|1,000}} on death. *'''25 June 2025''' - [[v1.68.0]] **First wave appearance changed from Wave 29 to Wave 22. **Health decreased from 750 to 225. **Cash given decreased from {{Money|1,000}} to {{Money|250}}. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health increased from 225 to 250. **Speed increased from Above Average (4) to Slightly Fast (4.5). *'''11 February 2026''' - [[v1.85.0]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. {{Fallen|[[Corrupted Fallen]]|Wave 21|Fallen Seraph|Wave 22|[[Fallen Jester]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
